description: Cancel a queued or running job. bounce_session: a bounce still queued never renders (its budget is refunded); one mid-render has its result dropped on arrival. convert_project: a running conversion has no stop — it completes, the job ends as canceled and its output is discarded; the credit is refunded only when the conversion itself fails. A job that already finished answers 409 already_terminal.

job_id.description: The job_id from doseedo_convert_project, doseedo_bounce_session or doseedo_list_jobs.

name: doseedo_cancel_job
title: Cancel a job
